# A generator change and a new generated consumer can each merge green and leave main's drift check red

**What went wrong.** #19530 changed the Warrant evidence generator (WD-HARN1:
bounded observer waits, `lock_or_recover`). #19539 (`vos-sched-fp-bitmap`) and
#19547 (`vos-sched-any`) each check in a harness generated by that generator,
and their BUILD files run `gen_evidence --check`, which fails on any drift. All
three PRs were green and all three merged, but afterwards `main` held two stale
harnesses. The failure surfaced only when the next PR touching those crates (the
VOS-D081 rebase) ran the drift check locally.

**Why.** Each PR's required checks ran on the merge ref computed when that PR
was last pushed. #19530's branch predated both VOS crates, so the build tool
could not select crates that were not there yet. #19547's CI ran before #19530
landed. No CI run ever saw the generator and the consumers together. The
build tool's trigger was correct (`warrant-grammar` is in `vosToolPaths`); the
gap is that nothing re-checks a green PR against the base it actually merges
into.

**Fix and rule.** The fix was to regenerate (`gen_evidence <crate>`), confirm
the diff is exactly the generator change, and re-run the suites and a sabotage
line. The fix rode in the next PR. When you rebase onto a moved `main`, always
re-run each touched crate's drift checks (`gen_evidence --check`, `vos-link
check-doc`) and do not trust the pre-rebase green: a generated artifact can go
stale without any change to its own inputs in your diff.
